subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements about the Summer Olympics of 2012 is correct?

options.text: Athens hosted the Summer Olympics of 2012
London hosted the Summer Olympics of 2012
Beijing hosted the Summer Olympics of 2012
Paris hosted the Summer Olympics of 2012

solution:
The correct answer is __**London hosted the Summer Olympics of 2012**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 2012 Olympics were staged in London from 27th July to 12th August 2012, London becomes the first city to have hosted the Games for three editions: in 1908, 1948, and 2012.
 
• The London Games were the 27th occurrence of the modern Olympic Games.
 
• ** Wenlock** was the official mascot for the 2012 Summer Olympics.

• The 2024 Summer Olympics is a forthcoming international multi-sport event that is scheduled to take place from 26 July to 11 August 2024 in Paris, France.
 
• Paris will become the second city to host the Olympics three times, after London (1908, 1948, and 2012).
 
• The Olympic edition of 1900 and 1924 was hosted by Paris.
 
• The 2024 Games will mark the third time Paris has staged the Olympics, coming exactly 100 years after they last hosted the Games.
 
• The Motto of 2024 Paris Games is Made for Sharing.
